name: computeClosureHashes

versions.rationale: Typed stub from the seed plan (Core model); throws NotImplementedError until its phase lands.

Implemented bottom-up over the SCCs. Each cycle member hashes its own content with one hash of the whole cycle and its external dependencies, as the plan asks that cycles hash together; units without edges are leaves, and a unit missing a content hash throws rather than hashing as empty.

docs: Bottom-up closure hashes for every unit, given each unit's own content hash. Units in `contentHashes` with no edges are leaves. Members of a cycle each hash their own content with one hash of the whole cycle, so a change to any member, or to anything the cycle uses, changes all of them.
